keyword.en: electric mixer pump vs diesel mixer pump
keyword.zh: 电动搅拌泵和柴油搅拌泵的区别

title.en: Electric Mixer Pump vs Diesel Mixer Pump
title.zh: 电动搅拌泵一体机和柴油搅拌泵一体机有何不同

description.en: Both mixer pumps print a 0.4 m³ hopper and a 400/500 mixer note. Power, output and distance rows are different.
description.zh: 两台搅拌泵都印 0.4 m³ 料斗和 400/500 搅拌机说明。动力、产量和距离行不同。

h1.en: Electric Mixer Pump vs Diesel Mixer Pump
h1.zh: 电动搅拌泵一体机和柴油搅拌泵一体机有何不同

directAnswer.en: The integrated mixer and the diesel mixer are concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai that mix and pump on one trailer. The electric page prints main motor 45 kW and mixer motor 14 kW, 21 m³/h and distance 100 m / 300 m. The diesel page prints engine 4108 / 66–75 kW, 25 m³/h and three stone rows, starting at 100 / 300 m. Neither page is a mixing plant.
directAnswer.zh: 搅拌泵一体机和柴油搅拌泵一体机是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵，在同一拖车上搅拌并泵送。电动页印主电机 45 kW、搅拌电机 14 kW、21 m³/h、距离 100 m / 300 m。柴油页印发动机 4108 / 66–75 kW、25 m³/h 和三行石子距离，第一行为 100 / 300 m。两页都不是搅拌站。

heading.en: Where Integrated Mixer Pump and Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump print different values
heading.zh: 搅拌泵一体机和柴油搅拌泵一体机哪些数值不同

body.en: Theoretical output: Integrated Mixer Pump prints 21 m³/h; Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump prints 25 m³/h. Dimensions: Integrated Mixer Pump prints 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm; Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump prints 4100 × 2200 × 3000 mm. Main unit weight: Integrated Mixer Pump prints 4500 kg; Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump prints 4200 kg. Series note: Integrated Mixer Pump prints 30 series with 400 mixer; 40/50 series with 500 mixer; Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump prints 30 model with 400 mixer; 40/50 model with 500 mixer. The same printed value on a shared label: Max. outlet pressure is 23 MPa on both pages; Hopper capacity is 0.4 m³ on both pages. These are printed cells on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other.
body.zh: 理论输送量：搅拌泵一体机印 21 m³/h；柴油搅拌泵一体机印 25 m³/h。外形尺寸：搅拌泵一体机印 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm；柴油搅拌泵一体机印 4100 × 2200 × 3000 mm。整机重量：搅拌泵一体机印 4500 kg；柴油搅拌泵一体机印 4200 kg。系列说明：搅拌泵一体机印 30 series with 400 mixer; 40/50 series with 500 mixer；柴油搅拌泵一体机印 30 model with 400 mixer; 40/50 model with 500 mixer。同一标题下数值相同的有：最大出口压力两边都是 23 MPa；料斗容积两边都是 0.4 m³。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上印出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。

heading.en: Cells that exist on only one of these pumps
heading.zh: 只在其中一台泵上出现的格子

body.en: Integrated Mixer Pump prints cells that Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump does not: Main motor / mixer motor 45 kW / 14 kW; Pumping distance (H / V) 100 m / 300 m; Max. aggregate size 4 cm and below; Delivery pipe diameter 100 / 125 mm. Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump prints cells that Integrated Mixer Pump does not: Diesel engine 4108 / 66–75 kW; Stone capacity (H / V, ≤ 1 inch) 100 / 300 m; 13 mm stone (H / V) 60 / 180 m; 24 mm stone (H / V) 40 / 120 m. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump.
body.zh: 搅拌泵一体机有、柴油搅拌泵一体机没有的行：主电机 / 搅拌电机 45 kW / 14 kW；输送距离（水平/垂直） 100 m / 300 m；最大骨料粒径 4 cm and below；输送管内径 100 / 125 mm。柴油搅拌泵一体机有、搅拌泵一体机没有的行：柴油机 4108 / 66–75 kW；细石输送（水平/垂直） 100 / 300 m；13 mm石子（水平/垂直） 60 / 180 m；24 mm石子（水平/垂直） 40 / 120 m。缺了的标题不能用另一台混凝土泵来补。

heading.en: How to read the two pages without merging them
heading.zh: 怎样分开阅读这两个页面

body.en: A mixer note about 400 and 500 mixers does not add a second full specification table. Open /en/products/integrated-mixer-pump/ for Integrated Mixer Pump and /en/products/diesel-mixer-integrated-pump/ for Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance. If a job needs a figure this pair does not print, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 关于 400 和 500 搅拌机的系列说明，并没有再附一套完整规格表。看搅拌泵一体机请打开 /zh/products/integrated-mixer-pump/，看柴油搅拌泵一体机请打开 /zh/products/diesel-mixer-integrated-pump/。河北品锦机械在河北邢台制造这些混凝土泵。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。如果工况需要这对机型没有印出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

question.en: Does Integrated Mixer Pump print the same theoretical output as Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump?
question.zh: 搅拌泵一体机和柴油搅拌泵一体机的理论输送量一样吗？

answer.en: No. Integrated Mixer Pump prints 21 m³/h. Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump prints 25 m³/h. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。搅拌泵一体机印 21 m³/h。柴油搅拌泵一体机印 25 m³/h。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does Integrated Mixer Pump print the same dimensions as Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump?
question.zh: 搅拌泵一体机和柴油搅拌泵一体机的外形尺寸一样吗？

answer.en: No. Integrated Mixer Pump prints 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm. Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump prints 4100 × 2200 × 3000 mm. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。搅拌泵一体机印 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm。柴油搅拌泵一体机印 4100 × 2200 × 3000 mm。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does Integrated Mixer Pump print the same main unit weight as Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump?
question.zh: 搅拌泵一体机和柴油搅拌泵一体机的整机重量一样吗？

answer.en: No. Integrated Mixer Pump prints 4500 kg. Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump prints 4200 kg. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。搅拌泵一体机印 4500 kg。柴油搅拌泵一体机印 4200 kg。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Why is main motor / mixer motor missing on Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump?
question.zh: 为什么柴油搅拌泵一体机没有主电机 / 搅拌电机？

answer.en: The Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump page does not print that label. Integrated Mixer Pump prints 45 kW / 14 kW. Leave the missing cell blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps.
answer.zh: 柴油搅拌泵一体机这一页没有印这个标题。搅拌泵一体机印的是 45 kW / 14 kW。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。
